name: duopore-public-duplicate-record-audit
description: Find repeated names or references in a list before you clean it up.

interface.longDescription: Find repeated names or references in a list before you clean it up. Paste the records you want to check. Choose whether to match names, references or both, and choose how text is matched. Get the source row IDs for each group of repeats. You decide whether the rows are really duplicates; the app does not merge them.
defaultPrompt: Find duplicate names or references in these records.
Show the source rows for each repeated entry.

positive.prompt: Use Duplicate Record Audit with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"records":[{"recordId":"01","reference":"001","name":"Acme"},{"recordId":"02","reference":"001","name":"ACME"},{"recordId":"03","reference":"002","name":"Beta"}],"key":"name-and-reference","matching":"trim-case-insensitive"}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 duplicate record groups found.","rows":[{"matchKey":"acme | 001","count":2,"recordIds":"01 | 02"}],"warnings":["Matching text does not prove records represent the same entity."]}
